name: Nekota Miyako
source:
She is a reporter in the newspaper club in charge of the school newspaper.

She is a very curious and headstrong type of person. When she gets carried away, she sometimes loses sight of her surroundings.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/saimin/index.html]official site[/url]]
